title: Kimi K2
before: Open MoE models topped out well below a trillion parameters.
problem: Training at that scale is unstable, and agentic skill needs data nobody had assembled.
breakthrough: A roughly one-trillion-parameter open MoE with about 32B active, trained with the MuonClip optimizer and heavy agentic post-training.
why: Open weights reached trillion-parameter scale with agentic capability, from outside the established labs.
next: Kimi K3 in 2026 took it to multimodal at a larger scale.
inherits: Trillion-parameter open models as a real category.
